data.name: Filemon
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Filemon means 'Soldier of Philo'. This name has biblical roots as it is mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in the book of Philemon. It is believed that Filemon was a wealthy man who had a runaway slave named Onesimus. After Onesimus encountered Paul and was converted to Christianity, Paul wrote a letter to Filemon urging him to forgive Onesimus and take him back.
data.numerology_meaning: Persons with the name Filemon tend to be loving, supportive, and self-sacrificing. They are driven by a strong inner urge to be of service to others. Filemon’s number 6 suggests that they will have loving relationships and be a natural nurturer. They are capable of putting the needs of others before their own.

seo.title: Filemon: Greek Name Meaning 'Soldier of Philo' in Christianity
seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning, origin, and religious significance of the Greek name Filemon, mentioned in the New Testament as a wealthy slave owner who forgave his runaway slave Onesimus.
seo.description_paragraph: Filemon is a Greek name that holds biblical significance as it is mentioned in the New Testament. This name is derived from the Greek word 'philos' meaning 'friend' and 'mon' meaning'soldier'. It is believed that Filemon was a wealthy man who owned slaves, including Onesimus, who ran away and was later converted to Christianity by the apostle Paul. After Onesimus' conversion, Paul wrote a letter to Filemon urging him to forgive Onesimus and take him back. The name Filemon represents the themes of forgiveness, friendship, and redemption.
